paragraphs: I am applying for the Private Equity Due Diligence Specialist role in New York. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli, after working at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. This role interests me because it combines quantitative and qualitative diligence with explaining private equity investments clearly to Financial Advisors and clients.

My investment analysis so far comes from my MBA. For a class project I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, built a DCF checked against a sell-side model, and built an LBO model using Capital IQ. My work experience adds the analytical base. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget and capital allocation across marketing channels and found 30% efficiency gains by benchmarking past allocations, and I prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership. At Lenovo I built scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

I know private equity from coursework rather than from a job, and I do not want to overstate that. What I would bring is careful modeling, clear writing for senior readers, and steady follow-through on monitoring and documentation. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support your senior investment professionals.
